query: What happened to prices and incomes in the town after the mill closed?

S1.author: Lee
S1.title: Example Book
S1.text: As noted earlier, prices in the town rose sharply after the mill closed in 1990.

S2.author: Diaz
S2.title: Sample Study
S2.note: Retrieval result, wording not checked against the original
S2.text: Household incomes in the town fell by a third between 1990 and 1992.

conclusion: After the mill closed, prices in the town rose and household incomes fell.

steps.why: it answers the prices part of the query and dates the rise after the closure
it is the only claim about incomes
steps.missing: income fall from 1990 to 1992 (B) → after the mill closed (Z): no source places the fall after the closure or links it to the mill

pieces.text: As noted earlier, prices in the town rose sharply after the mill closed in 1990.
